scope: Different-author source-only review. No M1736 runner, EDA tool, license query, network access, production attempt, canonical result, M1738 release, commit, or push was performed.

findings.finding: The future canonical stage copies only M1733 ptsta. It does not copy the sealed M1722 Formality proof or place its exact proof identities in the canonical payload, so the claimed two-proof canonical salvage is not self-contained.
findings.required_fix: Copy the exact sealed M1722 formality directory into STAGE before sealing, verify its exact population and hashes, and bind its source path plus marker/log/report hashes in the canonical receipt.

findings.finding: Coverage disclosure omits out_setup and out_hold, each of which has 2680 total, 2679 met, zero violated, and one untested/no_paths endpoint.
findings.required_fix: Parse and disclose out_setup and out_hold exactly in the source contract, future receipt, author receipt, tests, and reviewer-visible semantic gate; never call coverage complete.

findings.finding: runtime_scope.rpt is exact-hash pinned but semantically checked only as a subset, not as the required exact keyset and exact values.
findings.required_fix: Parse runtime_scope.rpt as unique key=value rows and require the exact 14-key mapping, rejecting missing, duplicate, extra, reordered-by-policy if order is claimed, or changed values.

findings.finding: The future runner verifies only the first main Tcl line, quit, summary, and epilogue. It does not independently prove that every logical Tcl command from set design_name through quit was echoed once and in order.
findings.required_fix: Bind the exact M1733 PT Tcl identity, collapse continuation lines deterministically, and require every one of its 89 logical commands to occur in order between the startup diagnostics and shell epilogue. Reject deletion, replacement, duplication, or reordering.

single_next_action: Create an additive revised M1736 source identity satisfying all four exact acceptance gates, then request a new different-author source-only review. Do not create M1738 for this failed identity.
